about.title: About
about.campDescription: UFUQ '26 is a week-long transition and leadership camp designed for students from SUFFA Dars who are moving on to pursue higher studies. The camp equips graduating students with the confidence, skills, and mindset to navigate the transition from traditional Islamic learning to higher education and professional life — while staying rooted in their values and knowledge.
about.adsaDescription: Alathurpadi Dars Students Association (ADSA) is a community organization supporting the students and alumni of Alathurpadi Dars — one of the historic centers of traditional Islamic learning in Kerala, India. ADSA organizes programs and initiatives to help students grow academically, professionally, and socially.
about.suffaDescription: SUFFA (Scholars Union For Fundamental Activities) is the active students' body of Alathurpadi Dars. It organizes academic programs, community engagement activities, and student development initiatives throughout the academic year.

hero.arabicSub: رحلة العلم والانتقال نحو الآفاق المعاصرة
hero.tagline: The Sanctuary of Sacred Learning & The Horizon of Tomorrow
hero.description: Step inside the story of Alathurpadi Dars, the guiding light of our respected Ustads, the leadership of ADSA, the 39+ Dars confederation of SUFFA, the foundational heritage mission of SUHBA (Students Union for Heritage and Base of Ahlussuffa), and the transformative 7-day journey of Camp UFUQ ’26.
hero.anatomySubtitle: A comprehensive study of identity, sacred geometry, color philosophy, and mission.

titleStudy.rootMeaning: Rooted in the Arabic root 'A-F-Q (أ ف ق), signifying the celestial horizon where earth meets the sky, the limit of visual perception, and the threshold into the infinite.
titleStudy.quranVerse: “Wa huwa bi-l-ufuqi l-a‘lā” (Surah an-Najm: 7) · “Sa-nurīhim āyātinā fī al-āfāq” (Surah Fussilat: 53)
titleStudy.campSignificance: In the Dars, the scholar sits in the intimate Halaqah. UFUQ represents lifting one's gaze from classical manuscripts to the vast horizons of contemporary universities and global society, without losing sacred grounding.

geometryStudy.desc: The UFUQ emblem synthesizes classical Islamic geometric art with modern upward momentum.
geometryStudy.point1Desc: Derived from classical Islamic tilework (Al-Murabba‘ al-Mu‘allaq), signifying solid moral grounding balanced on an active, agile pivot.
geometryStudy.point2Desc: A continuous vector rising from bottom-left to top-right, reflecting the upward journey from Dars studies into premier university research.
geometryStudy.point3Desc: The sacred open space at the core, symbolizing that all worldly knowledge remains incomplete without the inner circle of divine remembrance.

colorStudy.title: Quad-Chromatic Color System
colorStudy.desc: Every hue in the UFUQ palette carries profound symbolic and spiritual significance.
colorStudy.color1Meaning: The tranquil night hours of study (Qiyam & Mutala'ah) in Alathurpadi Dars; gravitas and eternal anchor.
colorStudy.color2Meaning: The gold leaf of illuminated manuscripts, the golden chain of scholarly transmission, and spiritual excellence (Ihsan).
colorStudy.color3Meaning: The lush Malabar coastal identity, living scholastic revival, and intellectual freshness in modern discourse.
colorStudy.color4Meaning: The organic warmth of classical paper, humility before the master, and moral lucidity.

manifesto.title: The 5W + 1H Master Matrix
manifesto.whatDesc: An intensive residential transition camp equipping Dars scholars for university degrees, research, and public leadership.
manifesto.whyDesc: Preventing epistemic disorientation when transitioning to universities, proving that classical ilm and cutting-edge academia harmoniously empower one another.
manifesto.howDesc: Through halaqah discourses, masterclasses by doctorate scholars, CUET/NET entrance strategy labs, and 1-on-1 alumni mentorship.
manifesto.whenDesc: 7 full residential days during winter break, culminating in personalized 3-year academic blueprints.
manifesto.whereDesc: Melmuri, Malappuram, Kerala — an unbroken sanctuary of traditional Islamic sciences for decades.
manifesto.whoDesc: Organized by ADSA, uniting 39+ SUFFA Dars institutions, with SUHBA preserving heritage and foundational student values, under the patronage of Dr. C K Abdurahman Faizy Aripra.

missionVision.title: Mission & Vision Declarations
missionVision.mission: To empower graduating Dars scholars with critical intellectual agility, academic research acumen, articulate communication, and leadership capacity, while preserving their sacred moral grounding and adherence to the unbroken scholastic heritage of Ahlussuffa.
missionVision.vision: To cultivate an illuminated vanguard of Muslim scholars who seamlessly navigate classical Islamic epistemology and contemporary global academia—shaping university research, civil discourse, and societal wellbeing with wisdom and integrity.
missionVision.motto: Rooted in Ilm. Ready for the World.

darsHeritage.title: Alathurpadi Dars: The Seat of Classical Scholarship
darsHeritage.subtitle: A living sanctuary in Malabar preserving the unbroken chain of traditional Islamic learning.
darsHeritage.description: For decades, Alathurpadi Dars in Melmuri, Malappuram has stood as an illustrious beacon of classical Islamic episteme. Far more than a classroom, a Dars is an immersive sanctuary where students reside alongside their masters, reading the great classical treatises—from Tafsir al-Baydawi and Sahih al-Bukhari to Jam' al-Jawami', Mukhtasar al-Ma'ani, and Ihya' 'Ulum al-Din—cultivating spiritual devotion, humility, and moral excellence.
darsHeritage.feature1Desc: Concentric circles of inquiry and deep contemplation under master scholars.
darsHeritage.feature2Desc: Living alongside teachers, infusing every hour of day and night with sacred etiquette.
darsHeritage.feature3Desc: Preserving authentic scholastic lineages connected across generations.
darsHeritage.quote: “In the Dars, learning is not merely an intellectual pursuit; it is the molding of the human soul in the presence of illuminated teachers.”

leadership.title: The Respected Ustads
leadership.subtitle: Venerated scholars who illuminate the path of knowledge and wisdom.
leadership.name: Ustad Dr. C K Abdurahman Faizy Aripra
leadership.role: Mudarris, Patron & Spiritual Guide — Alathurpadi Dars
leadership.bio: A revered scholar of profound intellect and spiritual presence, Ustad Dr. C K Abdurahman Faizy embodies the rare synthesis of traditional mastery and contemporary academic rigor. Holding a doctorate alongside his deep traditional credentials, he has guided generations of students to navigate both sacred sciences and university disciplines with unwavering ethical integrity.
leadership.quote: “Knowledge without ethical roots is fragile; with Ilm, our scholars stand prepared for any challenge the world presents.”

pillars.title: ADSA & SUFFA Fraternal Powerhouse
pillars.adsaDesc: The official governing body unifying active students and accomplished alumni. ADSA spearheads academic conferences, welfare initiatives, scholarly publications, higher education guidance, and major landmark transitions like UFUQ ’26.
pillars.suffaDesc: The heartbeat of daily student life. SUFFA organizes research circles, debates, cultural symposia, multilingual literary wings, and community welfare, uniting 39+ affiliated Dars institutions across Kerala.

suhba.title: The Philosophy of SUHBA (صُحْبَة)
suhba.subtitle: Companionship that transforms knowledge from texts into lived character.
suhba.desc: In classical Islamic learning, knowledge cannot be transmitted purely through ink and pages. It requires Suhbah—the sacred companionship, osmosis of character, and personal guidance between teacher and student, and between scholarly brothers. UFUQ ’26 carries this timeless concept into modern academia.
suhba.dim1Desc: Absorbing character, humility, and adab directly from the presence of saintly scholars.
suhba.dim2Desc: Enduring companionship on the dars mats, night-vigil reflections, and shared scholastic struggles.
suhba.dim3Desc: UFUQ’s perpetual mentorship circle pairing graduating scholars with alumni in premier universities.
suhba.dim4Desc: Living as an ethical compass in the wider world, serving humanity with mercy and illumination.

digitalCraft.stackDesc: Engineered on Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with high-performance static delivery on Firebase Hosting.
digitalCraft.featureAudio: Ambient soundscape player with real-time Web Audio API frequency spectrum canvas.
digitalCraft.featureLang: Complete trilingual engine (English, Malayalam, Arabic) with native RTL typography and alignment.
digitalCraft.featurePortals: Dual Portal architecture with dedicated verification for SUFFA Dars coordinators and organizers.
digitalCraft.featureAssistant: AI-powered camp assistant with serverless Gemini API and intelligent client-side fallback.
digitalCraft.featureOffline: Progressive Web App (PWA) offline banner, install prompts, and keyboard-first Command Palette (⌘K).
